Karnataka Professional Tax Update: February Deduction Increased to ₹300

The Government of Karnataka has revised the Professional Tax (PT) structure under the Karnataka Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act. The amendment is effective from 1 April 2025 and impacts salaried employees and employers handling payroll compliance.

Key Changes in Karnataka Professional Tax

1. Income Threshold for PT
Employees earning up to ₹24,999 per month are exempt from Professional Tax.

2. Monthly PT Deduction
Employees earning ₹25,000 or more per month will have Professional Tax deducted as follows:

₹200 per month from April to January and March

₹300 for the month of February

3. Annual Professional Tax Limit
The total Professional Tax payable in a financial year is ₹2,500 per employee.

What Employers Should Do:

Employers in Karnataka should update their payroll systems to ensure:

₹200 is deducted for most months

₹300 is deducted specifically for the February payroll

Timely payment and filing of Professional Tax returns to avoid penalties.

Conclusion:

The February adjustment helps align the annual Professional Tax liability of ₹2,500. Businesses and payroll teams should review their payroll settings to remain compliant with the latest Karnataka PT rules.

If you need assistance with payroll compliance, Professional Tax filings, or labour law updates, consult a compliance professional to ensure accurate deductions and filings.

Amendment in Maharashtra Professional Tax due dates:

the Government of Maharashtra has issued the Maharashtra State Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments (Amendment) Rules, 2026 under the Maharashtra State Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1975.

In view of the above amendment,

The due date for filling of Annual Return of Profession Tax has been changed from 31st March to 15th March
The due date for monthly payment and return filing has been changed from the last date of the month to the 15th day of the month.
Accordingly, from March 2026 onwards, PT must be paid on or before the 15th of each month.

Failure to comply within the revised timeline will attract applicable late fees and penalties.
